digest: 过去 30 天，共追踪到 21 个热门 AI 开源项目（主力语言：TypeScript, Python, Rust）和 12 篇最新 ArXiv 论文。GitHub 最热方向是「Agent 技能与工具」。

categories.name: 🧩 Agent 技能与工具
categories.desc: 把工程、产品、设计能力封装成可复用的 Skill / 工具模块

repos.name: morluto/rea
repos.description: Reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries.
repos.summary_zh: 用 AI 智能体逆向分析任意软件，从应用行为一路深入到原生二进制

repos.name: anomalyco/opencode
repos.description: The open source coding agent.
repos.summary_zh: 开源编码智能体，让开发者用自然语言直接驱动代码编写与修改，TypeScript 实现且星标超 21 万

repos.name: harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo
repos.description: 利用 AI 大模型和自动化工作流，根据主题或关键词一键生成高清短视频。Generate HD short videos from a topic or keyword with an automated AI workflow.
repos.summary_zh: 输入主题或关键词即可用 AI 工作流一键生成高清短视频，大幅降低短视频创作门槛

repos.name: stablyai/orca
repos.description: Orca is the place for working with a fleet of agents (e.g. Grok Bot, Claude Code). Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on deskt
repos.summary_zh: 用自有订阅统一调度 Grok Bot、Claude Code 等多编码 Agent，跨桌面、移动与远程运行时运行

categories.name: 🔍 信息搜索与抓取
categories.desc: 主动抓取社区、社媒、网页、GitHub 等外部信号

repos.name: xerj-org/xerj
repos.description: Local-first search engine and MCP server for AI agents. One Rust binary indexes code, docs, logs, JSONL/CSV and PDFs for BM25 full-text, vector and hy
repos.summary_zh: 单文件 Rust 二进制即可本地索引代码文档日志与 PDF，为 AI Agent 提供 BM25 全文、向量与混合检索，无需 grep 也能搜代码

repos.name: ModernRelay/omnigraph
repos.description: Object-storage native graph database with branching and typed ontology
repos.summary_zh: 基于对象存储的原生图数据库，支持分支与类型化本体，用 Rust 打造

repos.name: kividbio/kividb
repos.description: A fast, multi-threaded Redis® and Valkey alternative written in Rust: drop-in compatible, with full-text and vector search built in
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 写的多线程 Redis/Valkey 平替，兼容现有客户端且内置全文与向量检索

repos.name: cdcailf/cjkfold
repos.description: Fold look-alike CJK glyphs (Kangxi radicals, CJK radical supplements) so text extracted from PDFs matches again.
repos.summary_zh: 专治 PDF 提取中康熙部首等形近字不匹配问题，用 NFKC 折叠让 CJK 文本重新对齐

categories.name: 🧠 上下文与推理基础设施
categories.desc: 压缩、转换、整理输入，降低 Token 成本，加速推理

repos.name: tashfeenahmed/freellmapi
repos.description: 7.4 billion tokens per month. 34 free LLM providers. 635 free model endpoints. All behind one /v1 endpoint, plus any custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint
repos.summary_zh: 聚合34家免费LLM供应商共635个模型端点于单一/v1接口，自带智能路由、自动故障转移与密钥加密，月供74亿token

repos.name: lightseekorg/tokenspeed
repos.description: TokenSpeed is a speed-of-light LLM inference engine.
repos.summary_zh: 光速级 LLM 推理引擎，专为极致降低推理延迟设计，让大模型响应快到接近物理极限

repos.name: trymirai/uzu
repos.description: A high-performance inference engine for AI models
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 打造的高性能 AI 模型推理引擎，主打极致速度与低资源占用

repos.name: ranxianglei/billion-context
repos.description: A context-compression plugin for month-long single sessions (billions of tokens) ,small context windows (a 100K context is enough) and token savings (
repos.summary_zh: 用上下文压缩插件把月级长会话塞进100K小窗口，Token消耗直降五倍

categories.name: 🔬 模型训练与微调
categories.desc: 预训练、微调、对齐、评估等模型构建环节

repos.name: Folkbench/folkbench
repos.description: AI API 中转站评测排行与切换工具：实测可用率、延迟与价格 · Open-source AI API relay benchmark, rankings & switcher for Claude Code / Codex
repos.summary_zh: 实测各家 AI API 中转站可用率延迟与价格并一键切换，帮 Claude Code 和 Codex 用户避开不稳定线路

categories.name: 🎨 应用与前端
categories.desc: 面向终端用户的 AI 应用、UI 组件、聊天界面

repos.name: Comfy-Org/ComfyUI
repos.description: The most powerful and modular diffusion model GUI, api and backend with a graph/nodes interface. The fastest local inference engine in the world.
repos.summary_zh: 基于节点图界面的模块化扩散模型GUI与后端，号称全球最快本地推理引擎，让图像生成流程像搭积木一样自由组合

repos.name: MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search
repos.description: The job search that runs on your machine. AI job application framework built on Claude Code: evaluate postings, tailor CVs, write cover letters, prep
repos.summary_zh: 本地运行的 AI 求职框架，基于 Claude Code 评估岗位、定制简历、写求职信并准备面试，可 Fork 自持

repos.name: thesysdev/openui
repos.description: The Open Standard for Generative UI
repos.summary_zh: 让 AI 直接生成可交互 UI 的开放标准，把模型输出变成真正能跑的前端界面而非纯文本

repos.name: SegFault42/HeliosGen
repos.description: 🏆 Self Hosted Gen AI desktop app. Free alternative to Higgsfield, OpenArt, Freepik....
repos.summary_zh: 自托管生成式AI桌面应用，免费替代Higgsfield、OpenArt等商业平台，数据本地可控

categories.name: 📦 其他热门
categories.desc: 值得关注的其他 AI/ML 开源项目

repos.name: yt-dlp/yt-dlp
repos.description: A feature-rich command-line audio/video downloader
repos.summary_zh: 功能最全的命令行音视频下载器，支持数千网站并持续维护，是 youtube-dl 的活跃继任者

repos.name: oven-sh/bun
repos.description: Incredibly fast JavaScript runtime, bundler, test runner, and package manager – all in one
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 打造的超快 JavaScript 运行时，集打包、测试、包管理于一体，一个工具替代 Node 全家桶

repos.name: NationalSecurityAgency/ghidra
repos.description: Ghidra is a software reverse engineering (SRE) framework
repos.summary_zh: 美国国家安全局开源的逆向工程框架，支持反汇编、反编译与恶意代码分析，免费替代 IDA Pro

repos.name: debpalash/VoiceStudio
repos.description: VoiceStudio is the open-source, fully-local ElevenLabs alternative — voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription & audiobook
repos.summary_zh: 完全本地运行的 ElevenLabs 开源替代，集语音克隆、设计、视频配音、听写、转录与有声书制作于一体，支持 646 种语言

papers.title: Industrial ReMEmbR: Scaling Spatiotemporal Memory to Robot Fleets
papers.abstract: Warehouse robot fleets continuously observe operational conditions, but preserving these observations as reusable semantic memory incurs substantial computation, communication, and storage costs. For
papers.summary_zh: 提出面向仓库机器人车队的时空语义记忆框架，通过分布式压缩与共享机制降低计算通信存储开销，实现跨机器人长期可复用记忆

papers.title: Planning under Noise with Neural Operators
papers.abstract: Planning under uncertain control execution noise requires reliable feedback policies across diverse environments. We introduce Planning Under Noise (PUN), a neural operator that learns noise-aware val
papers.summary_zh: 提出PUN神经算子学习噪声感知价值场，实现未见几何环境下的可靠规划

papers.title: Efficient Edge-aware Attention Network for Graph Generation
papers.abstract: Graph generative models commonly use graph-specific Transformer architectures to jointly update node and edge features. However, these architectures do not directly benefit from recent hardware-aware
papers.summary_zh: 提出边感知高效注意力图生成网络，兼容硬件优化注意力实现，显著提升大规模图生成的可扩展性

papers.title: Cache Engineering for Agents
papers.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents can handle increasingly complex tasks, navigating long trajectories of observations and actions. As these trajectories grow, key-value (KV) cache I/O and storage beco
papers.summary_zh: 提出面向LLM智能体的KV缓存工程方法，通过缓存复用与压缩应对长轨迹I/O存储瓶颈及上下文超限问题

papers.title: GBClaw: An agentic AI framework for atomistic grain boundary research and mechanistic discovery
papers.abstract: Agentic artificial intelligence (AI) systems hold immense potential for automating complex workflows in materials discovery and design, but extending them to domain-intensive mechanistic investigation
papers.summary_zh: 提出面向原子尺度晶界研究的智能体AI框架GBClaw，实现复杂材料机理工作流自动化并加速机制发现

papers.title: Semantic Observability for Autonomous Systems Diagnostics
papers.abstract: Modern distributed microservice deployments generate massive volumes of heterogeneous, multi-format observability logs across physically and logically partitioned infrastructure. Isolating root causes
papers.summary_zh: 提出面向分布式微服务的语义可观测性方法，统一异构多格式日志语义表征以精准定位级联故障根因

papers.title: Joints, Camera, Action! Co-Generating 3D Motion and Video for Arbitrary Rigs
papers.abstract: Video generation models can now depict remarkably realistic motion. Yet it is unclear how to use this motion beyond pixels: to animate a specific 3D asset and replay the animation in its 3D scene. For
papers.summary_zh: 提出联合生成3D关节运动与视频的框架，可从视频直接驱动任意骨骼绑定并回放于3D场景

papers.title: UniWALM: Unified World Action Language Model for Embodied Robot Control
papers.abstract: Motivated by the human ability to integrate experience across language, perception, and action, we introduce UniWALM, a unified world-action-language model that learns video, action, and language in a
papers.summary_zh: 提出统一世界动作语言模型UniWALM，将视频动作语言映射至共享表征并互为条件与监督信号，实现具身机器人控制的多模态联合学习

papers.title: MindView: Benchmarking Generative Multi-View Spatial Intelligence
papers.abstract: Spatial intelligence has recently been assessed through generative tasks such as spatially grounded image editing, yet language-guided generation of spatially consistent views from partial multi-view
papers.summary_zh: 提出首个生成式多视角空间智能基准MindView，从部分视角观测生成空间一致新视角，填补语言引导多视角生成评测空白

papers.title: Learning Adaptable Dexterous Skills via Hybrid Dexterous Mimicking
papers.abstract: Dexterous multi-finger hands hold promise to unlock diverse skills like functional grasps, in-hand reorientation, and dynamic handover that the human-designed world assumes, yet existing learning reci
papers.summary_zh: 提出混合灵巧模仿框架统一目标导向强化学习与动作捕捉模仿，实现任意物体位姿下多指手功能抓取与动态操作技能的可适应学习

papers.title: Adaptive Multi-Token Prediction: How far should we go?
papers.abstract: Multi-token prediction (MTP) can accelerate language-model decoding by drafting several tokens and verifying them in a single target-model pass. However, the best speculation horizon changes with cont
papers.summary_zh: 提出自适应多令牌预测方法，按上下文动态调整推测长度，在保证解码加速的同时避免无效计算浪费

papers.title: Value-Rich, Differently Organized: Measuring Value Expression and Organization in AI-Generated Debates
papers.abstract: Current evaluation of LLM-generated debate largely focuses on argumentative quality, leaving the value structure of generated arguments underexamined. We introduce a diagnostic metric framework for co
papers.summary_zh: 提出诊断度量框架比较人参与AI生成辩论的价值表达与组织，揭示AI辩论价值丰富但组织方式异于人类
